AddImageMosaic.title: AddImageMosaic
AddImageMosaic.summary: Adds mosaics, Gaussian blurs, or solid color shapes to blur one or more areas of an image for privacy protection and saves the output image to the specified path in Object Storage Service (OSS).

AttachOSSBucket.title: AttachOSSBucket
AttachOSSBucket.summary: Binds an Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket to the specified project. The binding enables you to use IMM features by using the x-oss-process parameter.

BatchDeleteFileMeta.title: BatchDeleteFileMeta
BatchDeleteFileMeta.summary: Deletes the metadata of multiple files from a dataset.

BatchGetFileMeta.title: BatchGetFileMeta
BatchGetFileMeta.summary: Queries metadata of multiple objects or files in the specified dataset.

BatchIndexFileMeta.title: BatchIndexFileMeta
BatchIndexFileMeta.summary: This operation performs a batch index of object metadata by processing input files for tasks such as label detection, face detection, and location detection. The object metadata is then indexed into a dataset to support various data retrieval methods.

BatchUpdateFileMeta.title: BatchUpdateFileMeta
BatchUpdateFileMeta.summary: Updates some metadata items of files indexed into a dataset.

CompareImageFaces.title: CompareImageFaces
CompareImageFaces.summary: Compares the similarity of the largest faces in two images. The largest face refers to the largest face frame in an image after face detection.

ContextualAnswer.title: Q\&A API in AI Assistant
ContextualAnswer.summary: Phase II of AI Assistant, Q\&A API

ContextualRetrieval.title: ContextualRetrieval
ContextualRetrieval.summary: Retrieves semantically similar documents. The operation is designed for multi-turn conversations and can process message input in historical conversations. The operation returns results that are highly related to the current conversation based on an in-depth understanding of contextual content. It provides consistent and efficient information retrieval in multi-turn conversations.

CreateArchiveFileInspectionTask.title: CreateArchiveFileInspectionTask
CreateArchiveFileInspectionTask.summary: Creates a task to inspect a compressed file and retrieve a list of its contents without decompressing the file.

CreateBatch.title: CreateBatch
CreateBatch.summary: Creates a batch processing task that performs specified operations, such as transcoding and format conversion, on multiple existing files.

CreateBinding.title: CreateBinding
CreateBinding.summary: Creates a binding relationship between a dataset and an Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket. This allows for the automatic synchronization of incremental and full data and indexing.

CreateCompressPointCloudTask.title: Create a point cloud compression task
CreateCompressPointCloudTask.summary: Compresses point cloud data stored in Object Storage Service (OSS) to reduce network data transmission.

CreateCustomizedStory.title: CreateCustomizedStory
CreateCustomizedStory.summary: Creates a story based on the specified images and videos.

CreateFacesSearchingTask.title: CreateFacesSearchingTask
CreateFacesSearchingTask.summary: Searches a media set for the top N images most similar to a specified image or face ID. The operation returns the corresponding face IDs and bounding boxes, sorted by similarity in descending order.

CreateFigureClusteringTask.title: CreateFigureClusteringTask
CreateFigureClusteringTask.summary: Creates a figure clustering task. This task uses an intelligent algorithm to group the faces of different people in images that are indexed in a dataset.

CreateFigureClustersMergingTask.title: CreateFigureClustersMergingTask
CreateFigureClustersMergingTask.summary: Merges two or more figure clustering groups into a single figure clustering group.

CreateFileUncompressionTask.title: CreateFileUncompressionTask
CreateFileUncompressionTask.summary: A file decompression task lets you decompress specific files or an entire compressed package to a specified location. Supported formats include Zip, RAR, and 7z.

CreateHighlightTask.title: Create a video highlight clipping task
CreateHighlightTask.summary: Creates a video highlight task. This feature is in invitational preview.

CreateImageModerationTask.title: CreateImageModerationTask
CreateImageModerationTask.summary: Detects non-compliant content in images, such as pornography, terrorism, undesirable scenes, logos, and text-in-image violations.

CreateImageSplicingTask.title: CreateImageSplicingTask
CreateImageSplicingTask.summary: Stitches multiple images into a single image based on specified rules and saves the output to a specified OSS object.

CreateImageToPDFTask.title: CreateImageToPDFTask
CreateImageToPDFTask.summary: Converts multiple images into a single PDF file and saves the file as a specified OSS object.

CreateLocationDateClusteringTask.title: CreateLocationDateClusteringTask
CreateLocationDateClusteringTask.summary: The spatio-temporal clustering feature classifies files in a dataset based on their time and location. This feature works on indexed files, such as images and videos, that contain shooting time and location data. These classifications can represent content from a user's trip, where files have similar timestamps and locations. The classifications can also represent content shot at different places where a user lives or works. Analyzing the locations and time ranges of these classifications lets you categorize media files, create highlight reels, and generate photo and video stories.

CreateMediaConvertTask.title: Create Media Transcoding Task
CreateMediaConvertTask.summary: Create an asynchronous media transcoding task. This task processes audio and video files for media transcoding, media concatenation, video frame capture, and animated GIF generation.

CreateOfficeConversionTask.title: CreateOfficeConversionTask
CreateOfficeConversionTask.summary: Creates a document conversion task that converts documents, such as Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and PDF files, stored in Object Storage Service (OSS) into images, text files, or PDF files.

CreateSimilarImageClusteringTask.title: CreateSimilarImageClusteringTask
CreateSimilarImageClusteringTask.summary: The similar image clustering feature groups images that you have indexed in a dataset into clusters based on visual similarity. This feature is useful for scenarios such as deduplicating images or selecting the best shots. For example, you can use it to filter burst photos in an album.

CreateTrigger.title: CreateTrigger
CreateTrigger.summary: Creates a trigger to start data processing in Intelligent Media Management (IMM). The trigger is activated by event sources, such as Object Storage Service (OSS), and uses data processing templates to process media files, such as images, videos, and documents.

CreateVideoLabelClassificationTask.title: CreateVideoLabelClassificationTask
CreateVideoLabelClassificationTask.summary: Detects labels for scenarios, objects, and events in video content. This feature supports more than 30 categories and thousands of labels. Scenario labels include natural landscapes, life scenes, and disaster scenes. Event labels include talent shows, office work, performances, and production. Object labels include tableware, electronic products, furniture, and vehicles.

CreateVideoModerationTask.title: CreateVideoModerationTask
CreateVideoModerationTask.summary: Detects threats or non-compliant content in videos. This operation can be used in scenarios such as pornography detection, terrorism and politically sensitive content detection, text and image violation detection, undesirable scene detection, and logo detection.

DeleteBinding.title: DeleteBinding
DeleteBinding.summary: Deletes the binding between a dataset and an Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket.

DeleteFileMeta.title: DeleteFileMeta
DeleteFileMeta.summary: Removes the metadata of a file from a dataset.

DetachOSSBucket.title: DetachOSSBucket
DetachOSSBucket.summary: Unbinds an Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket from the corresponding project.

DetectImageBodies.title: DetectImageBodies
DetectImageBodies.summary: Detects human body information, such as the confidence level and body bounding box, in an image.

DetectImageCars.title: DetectImageCars
DetectImageCars.summary: Detects the outline data, attributes, and license plate information of vehicles in an image. The vehicle attributes include the vehicle color (CarColor) and vehicle type (CarType). The license plate information includes the recognition content (Content) and plate frame (Boundary).

DetectImageCodes.title: DetectImageCodes
DetectImageCodes.summary: Detects barcodes and QR codes in an image.

DetectImageCropping.title: Detect optimal image cropping regions by using AI model capabilities
DetectImageCropping.summary: Detects visually optimal cropping regions in an image at a specified aspect ratio by using AI model capabilities.

DetectImageFaces.title: DetectImageFaces
DetectImageFaces.summary: Detects faces from an image, including face boundary information, attributes, and quality. The boundary information includes the distance from the y-coordinate of the vertex to the top edge (Top), distance from the x-coordinate of the vertex to the left edge (Left), height (Height), and width (Width). Face attributes include the age (Age), age standard deviation (AgeSD), gender (Gender), emotion (Emotion), mouth opening (Mouth), beard (Beard), hat wearing (Hat), mask wearing (Mask), glasses wearing (Glasses), head orientation (HeadPose), attractiveness (Attractive), and confidence levels for preceding attributes. Quality information includes the face quality score (FaceQuality) and face resolution (Sharpness).

DetectImageLabels.title: DetectImageLabels
DetectImageLabels.summary: Detects scene, object, and event information in an image. Scene information includes natural landscapes, daily life, and disasters. Event information includes talent shows, office events, performances, and production events. Object information includes tableware, electronics, furniture, and transportation. The DetectImageLabels operation supports more than 30 different categories and thousands of labels.

DetectImageScore.title: DetectImageScore
DetectImageScore.summary: Calculates the aesthetics quality score of an image based on metrics such as the composition, brightness, contrast, color, and resolution. The operation returns a score within the range from 0 to 1. A higher score indicates better image quality.

DetectImageTexts.title: DetectImageTexts
DetectImageTexts.summary: Recognizes and extracts text content from an image.

DetectMediaMeta.title: Retrieve media file metadata
DetectMediaMeta.summary: Retrieves the metadata of a media file, including media format information and media stream information.

DetectTextAnomaly.title: DetectTextAnomaly
DetectTextAnomaly.summary: Detects whether specified text contains anomalies, such as pornography, advertisements, excessive junk content, politically sensitive content, and abuse.

EncodeBlindWatermark.title: EncodeBlindWatermark
EncodeBlindWatermark.summary: Embeds specific textual information into an image as watermarks. These watermarks are visually imperceptible and do not affect the aesthetics of the image or the integrity of the original data. The watermarks can be extracted by using the CreateDecodeBlindWatermarkTask operation.

FuzzyQuery.title: FuzzyQuery
FuzzyQuery.summary: Queries the extracted file metadata, including the file name, labels, path, custom tags, and other fields. If the value of a metadata field of a file matches the specified string, the metadata of the file is returned.

GenerateVideoPlaylist.title: Generate a just-in-time transcoding playlist
GenerateVideoPlaylist.summary: Creates a just-in-time transcoding playlist that generates an M3U8 file from a video file, enables instant playback after playlist generation, and performs on-demand transcoding based on playback progress. Compared with offline transcoding, this significantly reduces transcoding wait time and greatly lowers transcoding and storage costs.

GenerateWebofficeToken.title: Retrieve weboffice credentials
GenerateWebofficeToken.summary: Retrieves the preview and editing credentials for a document.

GetBatch.title: GetBatch
GetBatch.summary: Queries the information about a batch processing task.

GetBinding.title: GetBinding
GetBinding.summary: Queries the binding relationship between a specific dataset and an Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket.

GetDecodeBlindWatermarkResult.title: Get blind watermark extraction task result
GetDecodeBlindWatermarkResult.summary: Retrieves the result of a blind watermark extraction task for an image.

GetFigureCluster.title: GetFigureCluster
GetFigureCluster.summary: Obtains basic information about face clustering, including the creation time, number of images, and cover.

GetFileMeta.title: GetFileMeta
GetFileMeta.summary: Queries metadata of a file whose metadata is indexed into the dataset.

GetImageModerationResult.title: Retrieve an image content moderation task
GetImageModerationResult.summary: Retrieves an image content moderation task.

GetOSSBucketAttachment.title: Get OSS bucket binding information
GetOSSBucketAttachment.summary: Retrieves the project name of a project that is bound to a specified OSS bucket in the same region.

GetProject.title: Query project information
GetProject.summary: Queries information about a specified project, including basic information and statistics information related to datasets and files.

GetTask.title: Retrieve task information
GetTask.summary: Queries the information about a specified asynchronous task. Intelligent Media Management (IMM) supports various asynchronous data processing capabilities, each with its own task creation operation, such as CreateFigureClusteringTask for creating figure clustering tasks and CreateFileCompressionTask for creating file compression tasks. This operation is a general-purpose operation that allows you to query the details of an asynchronous task by task ID and type.

GetTrigger.title: GetTrigger
GetTrigger.summary: Queries the information about a trigger.

GetVideoLabelClassificationResult.title: Get video label detection task
GetVideoLabelClassificationResult.summary: Retrieves the result of a video label detection task.

GetVideoModerationResult.title: Retrieve a video content moderation task
GetVideoModerationResult.summary: Retrieves a video content moderation task.

IndexFileMeta.title: IndexFileMeta
IndexFileMeta.summary: Performs data processing on input files for tasks such as label detection, face detection, and location detection. This operation extracts object metadata and creates an index, which lets you retrieve data from a dataset.

ListBatches.title: ListBatches
ListBatches.summary: Queries batch processing tasks. You can query batch processing tasks based on conditions such task tags and status. The results can be sorted.

ListBindings.title: Query the list of bindings
ListBindings.summary: Query the list of bindings between datasets and Object Storage Service (OSS) buckets.

ListDatasets.title: ListDatasets
ListDatasets.summary: Queries a list of datasets. You can query the list by dataset prefix.

ListProjects.title: Query all project information
ListProjects.summary: Queries information about all projects, including basic information and statistics information related to datasets and files.

ListRegions.title: List of Regions Supporting IMM Service

ListTasks.title: ListTasks
ListTasks.summary: Lists tasks based on specific conditions, such as by time range and by tag.

ListTriggers.title: ListTriggers
ListTriggers.summary: Queries triggers by tag or status.

QueryFigureClusters.title: QueryFigureClusters
QueryFigureClusters.summary: Queries face groups based on given conditions.

QueryLocationDateClusters.title: QueryLocationDateClusters
QueryLocationDateClusters.summary: Queries a list of spatiotemporal clusters based on the specified conditions.

QuerySimilarImageClusters.title: QuerySimilarImageClusters
QuerySimilarImageClusters.summary: You can call this operation to query the list of similar image clusters.

QueryStories.title: QueryStories
QueryStories.summary: Queries stories based on the specified conditions.

RefreshWebofficeToken.title: Refresh a weboffice token
RefreshWebofficeToken.summary: Refreshes a Weboffice access token. A Weboffice access token is valid for 30 minutes. After it expires, you can no longer access Weboffice. To continue accessing Weboffice, call this operation to refresh the Weboffice access token and obtain a new token that is also valid for 30 minutes.

ResumeBatch.title: ResumeBatch
ResumeBatch.summary: Resumes a batch processing task that is in the Suspended or Failed state.

ResumeTrigger.title: ResumeTrigger
ResumeTrigger.summary: Resumes a trigger that is in the Suspended or Failed state.

SearchImageFigureCluster.title: SearchImageFigureCluster
SearchImageFigureCluster.summary: Queries face clusters that contain a specific face in an image. Each face cluster contains information such as bounding boxes and similarity.

SemanticQuery.title: SemanticQuery
SemanticQuery.summary: Queries metadata in a dataset by inputting natural language.

SimpleQuery.title: SimpleQuery
SimpleQuery.summary: Queries files in a dataset by performing a simple query operation. The operation supports logical expressions.

UpdateBatch.title: UpdateBatch
UpdateBatch.summary: Updates information for a batch processing task, such as the data source configuration, data processing configuration, and tags.

UpdateDataset.title: Update a dataset
UpdateDataset.summary: Updates the information of a dataset.

UpdateFigureCluster.title: UpdateFigureCluster
UpdateFigureCluster.summary: Updates information about a face cluster, such as the cluster name and labels.

UpdateFileMeta.title: UpdateFileMeta
UpdateFileMeta.summary: Updates the partial metadata of the indexed files in a dataset.

UpdateProject.title: Update a project
UpdateProject.summary: Updates the information of a created project.

UpdateStory.title: UpdateStory
UpdateStory.summary: Updates the information about a story, such as the story name and cover image.

UpdateTrigger.title: UpdateTrigger
UpdateTrigger.summary: Updates information about a trigger, such as the input data source, data processing settings, and tags.
